rdfs:label: holds
rdfs:comment: An ORG Post (position) that an Agent currently holds within an Organization.
notes: Use to declare that an Agent (usually a Person, but organizations and software agents can too) currently occupies a named Post (org:Post) — "holds the position of CTO". Inverse of `urn:solid:heldBy`. A Post is a stable, identified position that may be held by different people over time, distinct from Membership (which is the participation event itself).

history.note: Domain widened to Agent (upstream foaf:Agent), range Post added; seeAlso now Post/heldBy/postIn/Membership (dropped unrelated hadRole); notes state inverse of heldBy.
